entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Dessalines and the Declaration of Independence, a transformative movement in Haiti (1802–1804). Emerged from Toussaint promulgates autonomous constitution 1801 and Toussaint defeats British invasion force 1798. Catalyzed Battle of Vertières — decisive defeat of French forces, November 18, 1803 and Assassination of Emperor Dessalines 1806.
